   URGENT - IMMEDIATE BROADCAST REQUESTED
   Tornado Watch Number 703
   NWS Storm Prediction Center Norman OK
   735 PM CST Mon Nov 2 2026

   The NWS Storm Prediction Center has issued a

   * Tornado Watch for portions of
     Northwest Arkansas
     Southeast Kansas
     Southwest Missouri
     Eastern Oklahoma

   * Effective this Monday night and Tuesday morning from 735 PM
     until 300 AM CST.

   * Primary threats include...
     A couple tornadoes possible
     Scattered damaging wind gusts to 70 mph possible

   SUMMARY...Clusters of thunderstorms and embedded supercells should
   continue to pose some risk for severe/damaging winds as they spread
   east-northeastward this evening into early Tuesday morning. A couple
   of embedded tornadoes may also occur.

   The tornado watch area is approximately along and 65 statute miles
   east and west of a line from 35 miles west northwest of Joplin MO to
   20 miles east of Durant OK. For a complete depiction of the watch
   see the associated watch outline update (WOUS64 KWNS WOU3).

   PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

   REMEMBER...A Tornado Watch means conditions are favorable for
   tornadoes and severe thunderstorms in and close to the watch
   area. Persons in these areas should be on the lookout for
   threatening weather conditions and listen for later statements
   and possible warnings.
